import.retained: The mutable supplier machine contract is not stored locally. PontxSpec is the independently curated canonical contract after one-time import and source-by-source review.

terms.policy: The local SDK/CLI connects directly with caller-owned credentials. Hub proxying, caching, persistence, and response display are disabled because the terms prohibit reproducing, reselling, or providing supplier information without a licence.

riskReview.execution: All Hub execution is disabled. The local SDK and CLI send requests directly to the supplier with the caller's App ID; Hub never receives, stores, caches, or displays supplier responses.

derivation.boundary: All seven official v0.7 read-only GET endpoints.
rawContractNormalizations: Converted /historical/:date.json to the literal path template /historical/{date}.json.
Replaced supplier hyphenated operation identifiers with stable lower-camel Pontx operation IDs.
Reconstructed missing component schemas from the official endpoint response examples and schemas; explicitly preserved the official convert success schema and example.
